bands.COMPARATOR_IS_BINDING: availability delta >= +0.30 AND recall@1 delta < +0.03 -- the answer is on the menu and still is not chosen. PRE-DECLARED FULLY EXPECTED AND ACCEPTABLE.
bands.HURTS: recall@1 delta <= -0.03 -- more candidates means more distractors. A live possibility, not a formality.
bands.BROKEN: availability does not rise -- the manipulation failed; nothing else is interpreted.
bands.power: n=1353 v5 probe subjects: SE(proportion near 0.05) = 0.006, SE(delta) <= 0.019, so +0.03 is resolvable at >1.5 SE and +0.10 at >5 SE.
